PreToolUse.command: cd siphon-cli && npm run typecheck && npx biome check src && cd ../siphon-daemon && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy -- -D warnings
PreToolUse.description: Run TypeScript + Biome + Rust checks before committing

PostToolUse.command: cd siphon-cli && npx biome format src --write --quiet 2>&1 | tail -5 || true
PostToolUse.description: Auto-format TypeScript files with Biome after edits
